description: Header file defining the PID AutoTune class and related constants, structures, and macros for PID auto-tuning algorithms in embedded systems.

classes.name: PID_AutoTune
classes.description: Class implementing PID auto-tuning algorithms with various tuning rules and parameters.

classes.name: Tuning
classes.description: Structure representing tuning rule divisors and methods for PI/PID controller tuning.

methods.name: Runtime
methods.description: Performs auto-tuning computation, returns true when tuning is complete.

methods.name: SetOutputStep
methods.description: Sets the output step size for auto-tuning.

methods.name: GetOutputStep
methods.description: Retrieves the current output step size.

methods.name: GetControlType
methods.description: Gets the current tuning algorithm type.

methods.name: SetLookbackSec
methods.description: Sets the lookback period in seconds for peak detection.

methods.name: GetLookbackSec
methods.description: Gets the lookback period in seconds.

methods.name: SetNoiseBand
methods.description: Sets the noise band threshold for signal chatter.

methods.name: GetKp
methods.description: Returns the computed proportional gain after tuning.

methods.name: GetKi
methods.description: Returns the computed integral gain after tuning.

methods.name: GetKd
methods.description: Returns the computed derivative gain after tuning.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the output value during auto-tuning.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the finite state machine state of the auto-tuner.

methods.name: setPeakType
methods.description: Sets the peak type for peak detection.
